title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
ii.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
iii.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
iv.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
v.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
